changelog: Risk Calculator: every challenge except Bitfunded Altcoin showed Risk % as '—' and left Risk $/Position/Margin/Stops to Fail blank, because risk_ladder_tiers had zero active rows for any challenge besides challenge 6 -- no code anywhere ever wrote a ladder row for a new challenge. Root cause, not a per-challenge bug.

Added a Risk Ladder editor to Edit Challenge: add/edit/remove tiers, with server-side validation (no gaps, no overlaps, first tier starts at $0, only the last tier is open-ended, risk % > 0 and <= 10%). Saving deactivates the previous active tiers and inserts the new ones, same active=0 history pattern challenge 6's own rows 1-3 already established by hand.

New Challenge now requires one typed risk % for an initial $0-and-up ladder tier -- no hidden default. Challenge insert and ladder insert are one transaction; a challenge can no longer be created with zero ladder rows.

Calculator fallback: a challenge with no active ladder now shows a clearly-labelled, editable Risk % input (CalculatorController::autoRiskPreview()'s new manual_risk_pct, one-shot and never persisted) instead of leaving every sizing output blank. A real ladder tier always takes priority when one exists.

Existing challenges (hyrotrader trial, Bitfunded BTC, Bitfunded tradefi) were deliberately NOT auto-filled with any ladder -- their tiers stay empty until set in the new editor. Challenge 6's own $9,250/$9,500 thresholds were not copied anywhere.

migrate.php: a migration that failed on a previous run showed as plain 'pending' on every later status check, with no sign anything had gone wrong until the next run re-attempted it -- the error was always recorded in schema_migrations.error_message, just never surfaced again after the moment it happened. mode=status now shows 'failed previously -- retryable' plus the recorded error inline for exactly this case.
release_notes: No DB migration this release -- risk_ladder_tiers already had every column the ladder editor needed (challenge_id, lower_balance, upper_balance, risk_pct, active); everything built is application code (ChallengeController::getLadder()/saveLadder()/validateLadderTiers(), two new router actions, CalculatorController::autoRiskPreview()'s manual_risk_pct fallback, the Challenges modal's two new sections, calculator.js's manual-input toggle, migrate.php's pending-detail reporting). Investigated and confirmed already correct, no change needed: migrate.php's mode=run never marks a migration 'applied' unless every statement in it succeeded, and a SQL error during mode=run was already captured in schema_migrations.error_message and shown in that run's own result list -- the actual gap was narrower, that error becoming invisible again on a later plain status check, which this release fixes directly. The missing 2026_10_19_0001 migration on live is most likely explained by updater.php's apply action never having been run to completion for v3.27.1 before the lot_size fix was applied by hand -- confirmed from the code that a failed/skipped file download would have shown as a red error line in the Update Log, not silently nothing; not confirmable with certainty without server-side history this environment doesn't have access to. php -l on every changed PHP file and node --check on every changed JS file pass clean; duplicate-name scan clean; full tools/ui-harness suite passes (drive-v32210.mjs's one timeout was the pre-existing documented flake from v3.26.1's own notes, confirmed by an isolated re-run passing clean, and unrelated -- none of this release's changes touch any backtest file).
